body: DayOne's list of the game's vehicles files it under Trucks.
DayOne gives its stats as speed 2.6, acceleration 1.9, asphalt handling 2.5, off-road handling 2.8, strength 3.0.
In-game stat bars (out of 10): Speed 2.6, Acceleration 1.9, Asphalt handling 2.5, Off-road handling 2.8, Strength 3.0, read from the game by two sources.

name: Stanley Furrow TC 2350
summary: The Stanley Furrow TC 2350 is an industrial vehicle listed in the released game's vehicle database (era 2010s Current).
body: DayOne's list of the game's vehicles files it under Industrial Vehicles.
DayOne prints the maker as "Stanely"; the app's pre-launch Fieldmaster tractor entry uses "Stanley", and it is not confirmed whether they are the same vehicle.
An in-game picture on GTABase shows the maker as Stanley, so "Stanely" looks like a misprint.
In-game stat bars (out of 10): Speed 1.0, Acceleration 0.3, Asphalt handling 1.0, Off-road handling 3.0, Strength 3.5, as read by GTABase only so far.
